summary: Use runtime fallback when an event listener can be a Proxy/dynamic EventListener object whose handleEvent lookup is observable.

semantics.callback: EventListener objects can use handleEvent with dynamic property lookup/call semantics
semantics.identity: listener object identity determines duplicate suppression/removal

caveats: Do not convert arbitrary listener objects to delegates eagerly; handleEvent/proxy behavior may be dynamic.
references: WHATWG DOM Living Standard § EventListener / EventTarget

tests.name: handleEvent object
tests.input: const t=new EventTarget(); const o={handleEvent(e){console.log(e.type)}}; t.addEventListener('x',o); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('x'));

tests.name: same object identity is registration key
tests.input: const t=new EventTarget(); let n=0; const o={handleEvent(){n++}}; t.addEventListener('x',o); t.addEventListener('x',o); t.dispatchEvent(new Event('x')); console.log(n);
